title: Chemist-aligned retrosynthesis by ensembling diverse inductive bias models
title_zh: 化学家偏好的多模型集成合成预测
abstract: Chemical synthesis remains a critical bottleneck in the discovery and manufacture of functional small molecules1−3. While AI-assisted synthesis planning has proliferated in recent years, a detailed understanding of its failure modes has not been achieved, and models still struggle with predicting less frequent, yet strategically critical reactions, as well as hallucinated, incorrect predictions misaligned with chemists’ expectations4−12. In this work, we analyze the failure modes of current AI models and propose RetroChimera: a frontier retrosynthesis model, built upon two newly developed components with complementary inductive biases, integrated via a novel, learning-based ensembling strategy. Through experiments across several orders of magnitude in data scale, we show RetroChimera outperforms leading baselines, demonstrating robustness outside the training data, as well as the ability to learn from very small numbers of examples per reaction class. Using both pairwise and pointwise setups, we find that organic chemists prefer predictions from RetroChimera over published reference reactions and over other AI models. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot transfer and fine-tuning on internal datasets from two major pharmaceutical companies, showing robust generalization under distribution shift. Our work demonstrates the viability of deep learning for accurate synthesis prediction in increasingly challenging regimes.
abstract_zh: 化学合成仍然是功能小分子发现和制造的关键瓶颈。尽管近年来AI辅助合成规划层出不穷，但尚未实现对其失效模式的详细理解，且模型在预测不太常见但策略上关键的反应方面仍然存在困难，同时也难以预测与化学家预期不符的幻觉性错误预测。在本研究中，我们分析了当前AI模型的失效模式，并提出了RetroChimera：一种前沿合成预测模型，其基于两个新开发的具有互补归纳偏好的组件，并通过一种新颖的基于学习的集成策略将它们整合。通过在数据规模的数个数量级上进行实验，我们展示了RetroChimera在领先基线之上表现出色，表现出在训练数据之外的鲁棒性，以及从每类反应中极少的样本中学习的能力。利用成对和点对两种设置，我们发现有机化学家更倾向于选择RetroChimera的预测结果，而不是已发表的参考反应以及其他AI模型。最后，我们展示了在两家大型制药公司内部数据集上的零样本迁移和微调，展示了在分布偏移下的鲁棒性泛化。我们的研究展示了深度学习在日益挑战性的领域中实现准确合成预测的可行性。
